user.title: Configure Frixos Device
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Frixos device

data.name: Name
data.password: Access password (only if one is set on the clock)

reconfigure.title: Change Frixos Device Address
reconfigure.description: Enter the clock's new IP address or hostname. Entities and their settings are kept.

data.password: Access password (leave empty to keep the saved one)

reauth_confirm.title: Frixos access password
reauth_confirm.description: The clock at {host} asks for an access password. Enter the password set on its web page (Settings, Connection). Home Assistant stores only a hash of it.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device. Please check the host and port.
error.invalid_auth: This clock has an access password. Enter it, or check that it is right.
error.auth_locked: Too many wrong passwords. The clock refuses logins for a while; try again in a minute.
